procedure: State: An approval process has repeated turnaround and queue observations under known staffing and demand. Procedure: Compare repeated handoff and total-route timings with earlier comparable periods, noting persistent or changing delays and relevant staffing or demand changes. Limits and stopping conditions: Sampling, demand confounding and changing case mix limit generalization.
action: Compare repeated handoff and total-route timings with earlier comparable periods, noting persistent or changing delays and relevant staffing or demand changes.
observables: Stable, rising or falling delay and queue patterns over time.
inferential_warrant: The trajectory supports bounded assessment of persistence or change; a timing trend alone does not identify its cause.
problem_decomposition: Ordinary handoffs, queues and case types.
next_inquiry: Inspect delayed cases and pilot a bounded handoff change with a matched comparison.
